items.title: Vodafone Idea to raise Rs 4,730 crore from Aditya Birla Group entity via warrants issue
items.description: Vodafone Idea has called an extraordinary general meeting on June 11 to seek shareholder approval for the preferential allotment.

items.title: Vodafone Idea swings to Q4 profit at Rs 51,970 crore on one-time accounting gain from AGR reassessment
items.description: Excluding the exceptional item, the debt-laden telecom operator showed steady operational recovery, with quarterly revenue rising 2.9% year-on-year to Rs 11,332 crore, while EBITDA grew 4.9% to Rs 4,890 crore.
